svg.title: WaveKit — category icon system
svg.desc: Eight category icons shown in dark, light and monochrome treatments. Standard 24-unit geometry, 2-unit strokes.

g.aria-label: 24-unit canvas / 2-unit stroke / rounded joins / one family
Tabler-based icons with three documented WaveKit extensions.
No mixed libraries. No satellite shorthand for APRS. Labels are separate from the reusable SVGs.
